Subject: Integration Lab Tour + co-marketing: Bridgecrest x Redwood

Hi Jordan —

Great speaking last week. Bridgecrest would love to run a joint \"Integration Lab Tour\" with Redwood this fall — a lightweight, hands-on series for developer and platform teams that showcases our end-to-end connector with Redwood Inference. High-level idea: a 3-city roadshow (SF, NYC, Austin) + a 60-minute kickoff webinar, a reciprocal blog swap, and a shared presence at DevSummit Boston (small demo booth + 2 speaker slots).

Quick asks on our side:
- Can Redwood commit to one primary speaker (field engineer) for the demos and a marketing contact for coordinated promotion?
- Are you open to a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines lead handling, branding, and promo cadence?

I've attached our partner deck and a draft MAP to get the ball rolling. Proposed target weeks:
- SF: week of Sept 13
- NYC: week of Oct 4
- Austin: week of Oct 25

If this is interesting, can you share availability for a 30m sync this week? Evan and I can be flexible.

Thanks — excited to explore.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Alliances, Bridgecrest
Bridgecrest Labs

Thanks for the thoughtful proposal — love the hands-on focus. We're interested. A few practical notes from our side:

1) Ownership: I'll lead partner ops and field coordination. Jordan will be exec sponsor. Marissa will lead marketing/promo. Vivek will triage booth logistics.

   - funnel attribution: which platform tags do we both need for campaign tracking?

4) Dates: Our preferred windows (to avoid other Q3 pushes):
   - SF: Sept 20–24 (pref Sep 21–22)
   - NYC: Oct 11–15
   - Austin: Oct 25–29

I've attached a lightweight runbook (inline) — basic milestones, deadline for creative assets, and two suggested promo email send dates.

Next steps: can we do a 30m sync Thurs 17 Jun at 10:00 PT? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short draft MAP with the two points above called out.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
